observed_source_gap: AudioStudioDialog._run returned before resolving a completed future and settling its shared task when the dialog was closed or superseded.
The Studio error observer recognized InterruptedError but classified current audio.jobs.RenderCancelled (RuntimeError) as failure.
changes: Capture only the exact real ProgressReporter returned by this operation's current presenter, with its matching operation ID.

If a queued completion belongs to a closed/superseded dialog, settle that captured reporter from the real future using existing progress.finish_result or explicit error type; do not access native controls, current presenter, notification tick, result callback, or new operation.
Capture cancellation at future completion so a newer task's stop flag cannot reclassify the old result; committed typed results and real failures remain authoritative.
Recognize current explicit speech and DSP cancellation types in the existing live observer path; never infer cancellation from a stop request alone.
tests: Actual ThreadPoolExecutor futures, current ProgressHub/ProgressReporter and OperationProgress methods, actual flushed private checkpoint files; explicit dead-control traps. Native widgets are not substituted for a Windows acceptance claim.
